entities.summary: The Restoration period, James II's Irish campaign, the Siege of Derry (1689), the Battle of the Boyne (July 1, 1690), the Battle of Aughrim (1691), and the Treaty of Limerick (1691) whose broken promises embittered Catholic Ireland.
